licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 49–51, bars 1–38 of No. 7 (Peters notes that it is often left out)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics, slurs and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. A possible small turn sign over Guglielmo's part in bar 32 is uncertain on the page and is not written. Playback tempo ♩ = 51, from Kuijken's recording (1:53, whose track also holds the following recitative, so Böhm's 0:23 for that recitative was taken off); Mozart gives the word Andante only.
